title: SM AC3C
text: Discrete-time or continuous-time synchronous machine AC3C excitation system including an automatic voltage regulator and an exciter, 10 inputs, 1 output, {Sample time (-1 for inherited)} sets Block sample time; {Initial field voltage, Efd0 (pu)} sets the initial output voltage, {Resistive component of load compensation, R_C (pu)} sets the compensation resistance, {Reactance component of load compensation, X_C (pu)} sets the compensation reactance, {Regulator input filter time constant, T_R (s)} sets the regulator time constant, {Voltage regulator proportional gain, K_PR (pu)} sets the proportional gain of the voltage regulator, {Voltage regulator integral gain, K_IR (pu/s)} sets the integral gain of voltage regulator, {Voltage regulator derivative gain, K_DR (pu.s)} sets the derivative gain of voltage regulator, {Lag time constant for derivative channel of PID controller, T_DR (s)} sets the lag time constant for PID derivative, {Maximum PID regulator output, V_PIDmax (pu)} sets the maximum output of the PID regulator, {Minimum PID regulator output, V_PIDmin (pu)} sets the minimum output of the PID regulator, {Regulator denominator (lag) time constant, T_B (s)} sets the regulator lag time constant, {Regulator numerator (lead) time constant, T_C (s)} sets the regulator lead time constant, {Regulator output gain, K_A (pu)} sets the regulator gain, {Regulator output time constant, T_A (s)} sets the regulator time constant, {Maximum regulator output, V_Amax (pu)} sets the upper limit of the regulator output, {Minimum regulator output, V_Amin (pu)} sets the lower limit of the regulator output, {Rate feedback time constant, T_F (s)}, {Value of EFD at which feedback gain changes, E_FDN (pu)}, {Rate feedback excitation system stabilizer gain, K_F (pu)} sets the rate feedback gain, {Rate feedback excitation system stabilizer gain, K_N (pu)} sets the rate feedback gain, {Alternate OEL input locations (V_OEL)} sets the oEL input location, {Alternate UEL input locations (V_UEL)} sets the uEL input location, {Alternate SCL input locations (V_SCL)} sets the sCL input location, {Exciter field proportional constant, K_E (pu)} sets the exciter field gain, {Exciter field time constant, T_E (s)}, {Rectifier loading factor proportional to commutating reactance, K_C (pu)}, {Demagnetizing factor, function of exciter alternator reactances, K_D (pu)} sets the demagnetization factor, {Exciter output voltage for saturation factor S_E(E_1), E_1 (pu)} sets the first saturation output voltage, {Exciter saturation factor at exciter output voltage E_1, S_E(E_1) (1)} sets the first saturation lookup voltage, {Exciter output voltage for saturation factor S_E(E_2), E_2 (pu)} sets the second saturation output voltage, {Exciter saturation factor at exciter output voltage E_2, S_E(E_2) (1)} sets the second saturation lookup voltage, {Gain associated with regulator and alternator field power supply, K_R (pu)} sets the regulator and alternator field power supply, {Minimum exciter voltage output, V_Emin (pu)} sets the exciter lower limit and {Exciter field current limit, V_FEmax (pu)} sets the exciter upper limit. Values come from the instance.
